text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "users should purchase their DECT cordless telephones in specialist retailers in Switzerland or Europe", "gist": "recommendation to buy DECT phones in specific European retailers"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "interference on UMTS telephone networks results in intervention by OFCOM and taking out of service of the cordless equipment", "gist": "interference causes OFCOM to intervene and disable the equipment"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Owners ... may be liable to the cost of the intervention performed by the Office", "gist": "owners who self-import may have to pay for OFCOM's intervention"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "DECT equipment sold in North and South America or Asia use different frequency bands", "gist": "DECT devices sold in Americas and Asia use different frequencies"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In Europe, these [frequency bands] are reserved for UMTS mobile telephony networks", "gist": "European frequency bands are reserved for UMTS networks"}]}
